Metadata.title: Lattice OS: Workspace-Native AI for Code, Documents, and Context
Metadata.description: Lattice OS is a workspace-native AI platform for conversations, code, documents, and persistent context, with prepared context, runtime routing, and trusted capability growth.
Metadata.keywords: Lattice OS, workspace-native AI, persistent context, prepared context, model routing, UCOL, code intelligence, document reasoning, AI workspace

hero.badge: Workspace-native AI · Prepared Context · Trusted Capability Growth
hero.subhead: Lattice is an AI workspace for conversations, code, documents, and persistent context — built so your system can understand more than the latest prompt.
hero.title: The workspace-native AI layer for evolving projects
hero.description: Work with memory-aware conversations, prepared context, and runtime routing that can grow with your system over time.

ucol.title: Different work deserves different runtime paths.
ucol.subtitle: Lattice routes work across different operating modes and model paths using task shape, context state, and system intent — while keeping workspace context and prepared memory at the center.
ucol.card1Body: Use different operating modes for different kinds of work instead of forcing every request through one flat response path.
ucol.card2Body: Escalate to stronger reasoning and higher-quality paths when the task justifies it, instead of paying the same cost for every interaction.
ucol.card3Body: Keep one evolving context layer across conversations, projects, and future capability surfaces so useful state does not reset every session.
ucol.card4Body: Resolve behavior on the server side using mode, context, and system logic — not just manual model switching in the UI.

memory.title: Conversations improve when context can carry forward
memory.subtitle: Lattice is being built around prepared context, memory, and retrieval-aware assembly so project state, prior work, and useful user context can compound over time.
memory.stat1Label: Context shaped by project and workspace scope
memory.stat2Label: Structured context instead of raw transcript sprawl
memory.stat3Label: Knowledge that improves as the system is used

features.title: A workspace-native AI system, not just a chat wrapper
features.subtitle: Lattice combines prepared context, runtime routing, document and project understanding, and trusted capability growth into one evolving workspace experience.
features.conversationDesc: Work inside an AI workspace that is increasingly shaped by project and context scope instead of behaving like a disposable prompt window.
features.codeDesc: Move toward deeper repo, architecture, and project-aware workflows instead of treating code as isolated snippets.
features.researchDesc: Use runtime modes and structured context to support deeper analysis, synthesis, and evolving research workflows.
features.hybridDesc: Let the system choose different inference paths for different kinds of work instead of collapsing every task into one generic lane.
features.memoryLayerDesc: Build on a context and memory foundation designed to persist useful knowledge across work.
features.infrastructureDesc: Grow from the hosted workspace into desktop and local execution paths with explicit trust and observability boundaries.

cta.title: Build with an AI workspace that can carry context forward
cta.subtitle: Start with conversations and workspace context. Grow into deeper reasoning, document-backed workflows, and trusted local capability as Lattice evolves.

pricing.title: Flexible Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Pay only for what you generate.
pricing.disclaimer: Prices are estimated based on standard usage.

infrastructure.title: Use the hosted workspace today. Grow into trusted local capability over time.
infrastructure.subtitle: Lattice already spans an authenticated AI workspace, structured backend routing, and an emerging desktop/local execution path. The direction is controlled capability growth inside explicit trust boundaries — not unconstrained automation.
infrastructure.card1Body: Start with the core web workspace for conversations, documents, and project context without needing the local capability stack on day one.
infrastructure.card2Body: Runtime behavior is increasingly resolved in the server layer so routing, context, and system decisions are more inspectable and dependable.
infrastructure.card3Body: Electron packaging and the Go harness are laying the groundwork for scoped local file, repo, and runtime capabilities.
infrastructure.card4Body: Local capability is being developed in bounded phases with explicit scoping, denial behavior, telemetry, and observability goals.
